# Request for Quotation – Group Mediclaim Policy 2026-27

**Client:** Apex Logistics Private Limited
**Registered Office:** Plot 14, MIDC Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400093
**Industry:** Logistics and Warehousing

## 1. Existing Policy

The expiring policy is underwritten by ICICI Lombard General Insurance with policy period ending 31-12-2026. Claims are serviced by Medi Assist TPA.

## 2. Coverage Requirements

| Benefit | Expiring Terms | Requested Terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sum Insured | 3,00,000 floater | 5,00,000 floater |
| Pre-existing diseases | Covered after 2 years | Covered from Day 1 |
| Maternity | Not Covered | Covered |
| Normal Delivery | – | Rs. 50,000 |
| C-Section Delivery | – | Rs. 75,000 |

Room rent is capped at 1% of SI for normal room and 2% of SI for ICU per day.

Co-payment: 10% on all claims for dependent parents.

Pre-hospitalization 30 days and post-hospitalization 60 days.

## 3. Procedure Sub-limits (Proposed)

| Procedure | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| CABG | Rs. 1,20,000 |
| Appendectomy | Rs. 33,000/- |
| Cataract | 10% of SI per eye |
